page: Vultr vbm-256c-3072gb-8-mi355x-gpu is a bare metal server configured with dedicated AMD EPYC 9575F processors. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, this system provides 128 physical cores and 256 vCPUs running at a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The processing power is paired with 3072.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 12.0 GB of RAM per core.

The server features an integrated accelerator array consisting of eight AMD CDNA4 MI355X GPUs, delivering a combined total of 2304 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM. Local storage is provided by 28608 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, supporting high-throughput data access directly on the bare metal chassis. A single complimentary public IPv4 address is included with the deployment.

Given the high density of both system memory and GPU memory, this bare metal configuration offers significant resource consolidation for enterprise-scale workloads. It is designed for large-scale artificial intelligence tasks, deep learning model training, massive parallel simulations, and high-performance database clustering where virtualization overhead must be avoided.
